en.headline: Hung Shui Kiu pilot project to create over 6,000 jobs, Paul Chan says
en.dek: The Financial Secretary said the consortium awarded the large-scale land disposal site will invest about HK$16.8 billion, marking a milestone for the public-private partnership model in the Northern Metropolis.
body: Financial Secretary Paul Chan Mo-po said on Sunday that the pilot area project under large-scale land disposal in Hung Shui Kiu is expected to create more than 6,000 jobs and represents a milestone for the new public-private partnership approach in the Northern Metropolis.

Writing in his weekly blog, Chan noted that the government had awarded the site in the Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen New Development Area to HSK New Development Limited, a consortium of six companies, for HK$1.03 billion. The group plans to invest approximately HK$16.8 billion across construction, logistics operations and commercial management.

Chan said the model mobilises private-sector resources and expertise to speed up progress while requiring the developer to provide public facilities and open spaces and to form and return certain land parcels to the government. He added that the successful tender provides a viable framework for future large-scale land disposal exercises in the Northern Metropolis.

zh.headline: 陳茂波：洪水橋先導項目料創造逾6,000職位
zh.dek: 財爺指獲批大面積土地處置先導區的財團將投資約168億元，標誌北部都會區公私營合作新模式的里程碑。
body: 財政司司長陳茂波周日在網誌表示，洪水橋大面積土地處置先導區項目預期可創造逾6,000個職位，標誌北部都會區公私營合作新模式的重要里程碑。
陳茂波指出，政府早前把洪水橋／厦村新發展區內先導區批予由六家公司組成的洪水橋新發展有限公司，成交價10.3億元。該財團計劃投資約168億元，涵蓋建造、物流營運及商業管理等範疇。
他表示，新模式有效動員私營機構資源、靈活性及專業經驗，加快項目進度，同時要求發展商興建公共設施及休憩空間，並平整部分土地交回政府，達致雙贏。成功招標為北部都會區未來大面積土地處置提供可行框架。
